Got it, Gideon. I won't pass the Vantorre seat news to anyone or put it in a channel, and I won't include it in any other conversation. Ruth and Nadia will hear it from you when you decide to share it.

If you want help getting ready for that conversation, such as talking points or a note to Ruth or Nadia, tell me what you'd like and I can draft it for you to review. I'd keep anything containing the renewal number out of it until you've decided how to raise it.
